prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished, production-plausible mobile app UI design proposal for Rakky Ride's PROFILE page. ONE portrait mobile screen only, displayed flat and straight-on, no phone hardware mockup, no perspective, no decorative background, no extra panels, no annotations outside the screen. 403 x 804 logical viewport proportions, render at high resolution. All interface text must be clean and spelled correctly.
Visual direction: compact, beautiful, white-forward Uber/Bolt-inspired account interface. White background, soft silver/mint surfaces, deep green #176B17 actions, charcoal #141A14 primary text, muted #586253 secondary text, fine silver borders. Small typography: 15px content, 13px labels/helpers, compact title 16px; small conventional 16–18px thin line icons. No oversized title, no giant avatar, no illustrations, no gradients, no new branding logo. Restrained rounded corners around 10–12px, 20px horizontal screen padding, balanced tight spacing. Content should feel carefully aligned, legible and uncluttered.
This specific screen represents an APPROVED DRIVER whose reviewed name and phone identity are read-only. Use ONLY fictional sample identity: Alex Morgan, alex@example.test, phone +234 ••• ••• 0123.
Detailed layout:
1. A compact 56px top app header, left circular back chevron with 44px touch target and title "Your profile" beside it. A subtle bottom hairline.
2. A compact summary row with 44px circular mint initials avatar "AM", name "Alex Morgan" (15px medium) and understated "Driver" text below. No camera, no upload button, no edit badge on avatar. A very small muted line below: "Photo uploads are not available yet."
3. Heading "Personal details" in 14px medium.
4. Three stacked elegant field rows, light silver background or white with fine silver outline, approx 62px height each, small icons on the left, small label above value:
   - user outline icon, label "Full name", value "Alex Morgan", small lock icon right. Locked value subdued but readable.
   - mail outline icon, label "Email address", value "alex@example.test", small pencil icon right indicating editable.
   - phone outline icon, label "Phone number", value "+234 ••• ••• 0123", small lock icon right. No Change link for this driver.
5. A compact pale mint info panel with a small shield icon and short two-line text: "Reviewed name and phone changes need staff review." No duplicate warning paragraphs. Do not claim the email or phone is verified.
6. Green full-width 44px high "Save changes" button, white compact label.
7. Below a fine divider, compact "Account" label and a tidy row "Delete account" with a small trash icon and right-aligned muted "Unavailable" badge. This is clearly disabled and non-interactive, not a red enabled destructive action. Underneath one muted caption "Account deletion is temporarily unavailable."
Keep the design compact in the upper/middle screen with comfortable natural remaining white space, no artificial huge gaps between sections, no bottom navigation, no switch role card on this current driver profile. The screenshot must look like a finished mobile product with sharp line icons, beautiful consistent spacing and concise copy. Preserve all exact labels.
